source.name: Item file final-warning
source.note: Derived: the weapon has no charge of its own; the Quantum time to empty counts from the first shot

catalyst.name: String Theory, Final Warning Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants 10% increased damage to marked targets. Minibosses and Bosses only receive 5% more damage.
Hits against marked Minors and Elites|Minibosses and Bosses have an 85%|25% chance to refund one ammo into the magazine.
